name: Camtel NBN II / Zamengoé Data Center
developer: Cameroon Telecommunications (CAMTEL) / Huawei-led Chinese consortium (China Shenyang International Cooperation)
notes: Centre region, Lékié division / Zamengoé (outskirts of Yaoundé, marketed as Yaoundé). Uptime Institute lists Tier III Certification of Design Documents for Camtel NBN II Data Center (A-grade design award; not constructed-facility certification). Camtel official site (checked 2026-08-12) markets a Tier 3-certified datacentre with local hosting, backup and cloud in its datacentre (A for service existence; 'certified' is Camtel's own wording). DCD (B) reports ~3,000 m2, ~$15m built by Chinese consortium incl. Huawei; News Upfront and CEMAC Eco Finance report operational/marketed; PeeringDB fac/10946 lists Camtel Datacenter Zamengoe-Yaounde (2 networks). Directory DCHub lists 3.0 MW (C-grade, uncorroborated - not used as official capacity).

name: CAMPOST Data Center Yaoundé
notes: Centre / Mfoundi / Yaoundé, Ave Konrad Adenauer. CAMIX official contact address is Immeuble Data Center CAMPOST, BP 788 Yaoundé (A); PeeringDB fac/10586 lists CAMPOST Data Center Yaoundé with 3 networks and 1 local exchange (CAMIX Yaoundé) (A-). DCD reports the facility cost FCFA 31 bn (~$52m) funded via Chinese concessional loan (B). Institutional/interconnection facility; commercial colocation not yet proven by a CAMPOST service page. No public MW.

name: MTN Cameroon Yaoundé DC
notes: Uptime Institute Cameroon awards list (checked 2026-08-12) records MTN Cameroon / Yaoundé DC with Tier III Certification of Design Documents only. Per CM methodology, design-award is NOT operational/commercial evidence: status kept as planned/design-awarded (correction vs earlier round-1 record that marked operational). Exact site in Yaoundé unknown. Grade A for the Uptime design-award existence; C for any operational claim (none found).

name: AVS Telecom Yaoundé data center
notes: Directory lead only (C): DataCenterPlatform lists AVS Telecom as Cameroon-headquartered colocation provider with AVS Telecom Yaoundé at Ave du 27 Aout 1940, Yaoundé. No operator primary page, technical specs or MW found; retained from first-round discovery as a C-grade lead per methodology (ISPs named only by directories are not upgraded).

name: ADAC (Africa Data Center) Yaoundé
notes: C-grade lead: LinkedIn company profile of ICCNET subsidiary ADAC describes Cameroon-based data-center services with primary location in Ngousso, Yaoundé 5, Centre. No independent facility details or MW; retained from first-round discovery as C lead.

name: NSIF (CNPS) active data center Yaoundé
developer: Cameroon National Social Insurance Fund (NSIF/CNPS) / Huawei
notes: B-grade press: Huawei-built active and standby data centers for NSIF, active site in Yaoundé, standby/disaster-recovery in Douala, modular data-center architecture. Institutional/state facility; no MW capacity published.

name: ST Digital DLA01 / Douala Data Center
notes: Littoral / Wouri / Douala port zone (Douala-Bonabéri, Bonanjo; DataCenterMap gives Immeuble Entrelec, 75 Rue de l'Union Française). Operational/marketed; Afrique IT News reports operational since end-January 2021. A-grade: ST Digital official datacenter pages (Douala, Tier 3 positioning, ISO 27001/TIA-942/HDS self-statements) and MINPOSTEL official article (2025-07-21) after ministerial visit 2025-07-14 naming the port-zone data center hosting public/private structures. Baxtel (C) describes first carrier-neutral Tier 3-built facility in Central Africa, 400 m2 colo room; CAMIX site confirms a third CAMIX PoP at the ST Digital DC since 1 July (2025). No public MW.

name: Orange Cameroun Data Center (Maképé, Douala 5e)
notes: Littoral / Wouri / Douala 5e / Maképé. Operational since May 2017. A-grade official Orange Business Cameroun page: one 'data center tiers III+' (Orange wording), 3 x 1,050 m2 stages, 340 racks across two white rooms, 24/7 operation, 99.82% availability claim, two separate MV public-grid feeds, two fibre landing points. B-grade press: inaugurated 2017-05-31 at Maképé by PM Philémon Yang (TechAfrika), ~16 bn FCFA investment (ActuCameroun). PeeringDB fac/10947 (Orange Cameroun Datacenter Makepe-Douala). No public MW.

name: Camtel Bepanda (Douala)
notes: Littoral / Wouri / Douala-Bepanda. A- for facility/interconnection: PeeringDB fac/10585 lists Camtel Bepanda with 5 networks and 1 local exchange (CAMIX Douala, PeeringDB ix/2541); CAMIX site locates its Douala interconnection node at CAMTEL Bepanda. Treated as operational interconnection/telco facility (also a satellite earth station per Wikipedia/Osidimbea); commercial colocation at this exact site not proven by a Camtel service page. No public MW.

name: Matrix Telecoms Douala data center
notes: C-grade directory/BGP lead: Inflect lists Matrix Telecoms Douala at Akwa I, Douala, Littoral, operated by Matrix Telecoms SA; BGP/IRR records identify Matrix Telecoms Douala network infrastructure (AS36955). No primary facility page or MW; retained from first-round discovery.

name: MTN Cameroon Douala Akwa technical center data centers
notes: B-grade press (Digital Business Africa, 2022-11-03): MTN Cameroon hosted government and ART regulator at its Douala-Akwa technical offices near Rond-Point 4ème where the operator's data centers are located; DataCenterPlatform also lists MTN Douala. Telco-internal data centres; no public MW.

name: NSIF (CNPS) standby / disaster-recovery data center Douala
developer: Cameroon National Social Insurance Fund (NSIF/CNPS) / Huawei
notes: B-grade press: Huawei-built standby/disaster-recovery data center in Douala mirroring the active NSIF site in Yaoundé, modular architecture. No MW capacity published.

name: Bafoussam smart-city data centre proposal (CAMTEL convention)

No primary confirmation, site or MW found in this run; status unknown (not confirmed planned/construction/operational). 2026-08-12 West-region sweep found no verified data centre in Bafoussam/Dschang/Foumban.
